scope: memory-floor sweep at maximum accepted input (2048x1024 pair, 128 regions) through the real review path; tsx dev harness included; no browser/server/OS
method: docker --init --memory/--memory-swap equal caps, 1 CPU, no network, 64 pids; max_input_probe.mts; refines the first coarse sweep (192m pass; 128/96/64 killed with no output)

arms.note: immediate bounded SIGKILL, no output, no hang

conclusion: The analysis path at maximum accepted input has a memory floor of ~144 MiB (peak 143.6-144.0 MiB) including the tsx/esbuild dev harness; a production-packaged runtime is expected lower but is unmeasured. Inside the 256 MiB service budget this leaves >=112 MiB headroom. Below the floor the failure is an immediate OOM kill (bounded; in a service context this lands in the intake execution-failure/deadline path proven to keep the queue serving).
